fnol_text: My name is Dana Quinlan and I live at 788 Cedar Lane, Dover, DE 19984. You can reach me on (555) 325-3876 or dana.quinlan@example.com. On 4 September 2025 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2025-00044. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Quinlan on (555) 325-3876 to acknowledge the claim. Dana confirmed the loss date as 4 September 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Aisha Laurent gave a statement by phone.
Dana sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
